text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that lip gloss gives such a lovely 
sheen! It suits your elegant casual outfit 
perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Wow...! Thank you so much, 
Flight-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, your guidance brings out the unique 
charm of each individual... You possess 
quite the impressive skill as always.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Beginners Welcome! Makeup Advice Session 
for Casual Wear." ...It seems there is 
much to learn here.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it definitely looks gorgeous, but... 
Makeup really is pretty tough after all.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! There are so many things 
to keep in mind~ Maybe I should just 
settle for doing whatever...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! Air Groove-san. Could you 
show everyone how you do your makeup, just 
for a moment?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's individuality comes out through 
their makeup! Seeing your style might 
serve as great inspiration for them. 
...What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, I see. Very well.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
No way! Air Groove-senpai is going to show 
us her makeup routine?! ...I-I guess I'll 
watch for a bit~...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
While skincare and base makeup are 
crucial, eye makeup remains truly 
indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For instance, when styling my eyebrows, I 
always use this pencil.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, "Uccello"! A heritage brand known for 
its exceptional quality, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Its water resistance is top 
tier—no matter how much I sweat, it will 
not smudge.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whether in training or during a race, 
maintaining my ideal brow line is 
essential. It is an absolute staple in my 
cosmetics.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! That's some insane dedication 
to beauty...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The shape of one's eyebrows drastically 
alters the impression one gives off. Not 
even the slightest compromise is 
permitted.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I also consult professionals at beauty 
salons on a regular basis. ...The advice 
of an expert carries profound weight.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
E-Even going to salons?! To think you put 
in so much effort...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Perfect eyebrows are not built 
in a day... One is constantly reminded of 
just how deep this discipline is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For example, the technique changes 
depending on your natural brows. If they 
are thin, you should first align with the 
lower brow and mark the guideline—

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing...! She's thought about every 
single detail...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It must be something truly vital 
to you, Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. ...This is one of the pillars 
of my routine—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A necessity to attain my ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Makeup helps you reach your ideal 
self...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At all times, in any situation. A figure 
commanding enough to inspire longing in 
every horse girl—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Only with such elegance and dignity can 
one stand as the ideal for all horse 
girls.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it is for the sake of reaching that 
ideal, I shall master this path as well—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How could I call myself the "Empress" if I 
neglected the effort to polish myself?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*! ...S-So cool...! I-I want to 
become my ideal self too...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look at them enthusiastically 
browsing the cosmetics... Their desire to 
shine is sparkling brightly!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You really are a wonderful teacher after 
all, Air Groove-san♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I merely demonstrated what the ideal 
should be. They were the ones who took the 
step forward. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you after school today... 
For "Sparkle! The Makeup Class for 
Reaching Your Ideals!" All the students 
are looking forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood, leave it to me. ...Though I 
did not anticipate it garnering such a 
reputation.
choice_data_list: You're truly trusted as a teacher.
You're truly trusted as a teacher.

Looks like you'll have plenty of juniors 
looking up to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood, leave it to me. ...Though I 
did not anticipate it garnering such a 
reputation.
choice_data_list: You're truly trusted as a teacher.
You're truly trusted as a teacher.

Looks like you'll have plenty of juniors 
looking up to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, a teacher, is it? ...If they place 
their expectations on me as an instructor, 
I must live up to them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, exactly! Let's make everyone shine 
together, Teacher Air Groove♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's right! In fact, there are already 
so many girls who started using the exact 
same makeup tools as you, Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
With eyes sparkling, expressing their 
desire to be like me, no doubt. ...Hmph. I 
must devote myself even further to remain 
their ideal.
